people.name: Peter

people.name: a_wife_of_Peter
people.line: Wife of Peter, whose mother Jesus healed

translations.web: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?
translations.bsb: Have we no right to take along a believing wife, as do the other apostles and the Lord’s brothers and Cephas?
translations.kjv: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
translations.asv: Have we no right to lead about a wife that is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
